en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Sayf Bin Ameyra who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘How few are the ones who are grateful for the act of kindness’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from al-Hassan ibn Mahbub from Sayf ibn ‘Amirah who has said the following:
“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘How few are those who appreciate Benevolent Assistance!”’
